tool_input.command:
cat >> .sddpp/debt/frontend.yaml <<'EOF'
  - id: DEBT-FE-002
    title: The delete confirmation and the failed-DELETE path are only checked by string match
    description: The only test of the Delete button in public/app.js matches /confirm(/ and /DELETE/ in the script source. Nothing proves that cancelling the confirm leaves the task alone, so removing the "return" after the confirm would still pass the suite. Like DEBT-FE-001, the click handler also ignores a failed DELETE (no response.ok check, no message) and just reloads the list.
    kind: test
    origin: { type: slice, ref: SL-006 }
    created: 2026-10-25
    proposed_by: ai
    cost_of_delay: { level: medium, rationale: "The confirmation is the only guard on an irreversible action (undo is a non-goal), and a regression in it would be silent." }
    trigger: Before any slice that adds destructive page actions, or when a browser-level test harness is introduced.
    status: proposed
EOF
cat >> .sddpp/debt/backend.yaml <<'EOF'
  - id: DEBT-BE-005
    title: DELETE /api/tasks/:id parses the id with Number() and accepts non-canonical forms
    description: src/app.ts calls Number(c.req.param("id")), so ids such as "0x1" or "1e0" resolve to 1 and delete task 1 instead of answering 404. No test covers a non-numeric or non-canonical id.
    kind: design
    origin: { type: slice, ref: SL-006 }
    created: 2026-10-25
    proposed_by: ai
    cost_of_delay: { level: low, rationale: "The only client is the page, which sends the numeric id it received; a hand-made request can only delete a task the owner could already delete." }
    trigger: When the next id-addressed route (rename, complete) is added, so the parsing is shared and validated once.
    status: proposed
EOF
tail -c 300 .sddpp/debt/backend.yaml | head -3
cat > .sddpp/audit-input.json <<'EOF'
{
  "commits": [
    { "sha": "39c92d6ec068640b63c8c5cfffbb121d732f9cb1", "kind": "red" },
    { "sha": "6d8d9d6046a8bae0c11648410cb4896d99923f48", "kind": "green" }
  ],
  "tests_added": 6,
  "mutation_score": null,
  "decisions": [],
  "debt_created": ["DEBT-FE-002", "DEBT-BE-005"],
  "deviations": [
    "Mutation testing was not run (Stryker is installed but no run was made in this audit), so mutation_score is null.",
    "The page behavior (confirm before delete, reload after delete) is verified only by a string match on public/app.js; no browser ran it. Recorded as DEBT-FE-002.",
    "The 404 error body {error:{code:'not_found',message}} follows the shape used elsewhere in the API; this was chosen in green without a recorded decision and needs no ADR.",
    "AC-1 'does not return after a restart' is covered with kill -9 + restart in the tests; no separate graceful-shutdown case."
  ]
}
EOF
ppc finish SL-006 --audit .sddpp/audit-input.json

result:
SL-006 está cerrado: `ppc finish` aceptó la auditoría y el cierre quedó en el commit `c9b4b1a`, `chore(SL-006): close slice`.

**Lo que se entregó**
- `DELETE /api/tasks/:id` responde 204 si borra la tarea y 404 `not_found` si no existe.
- La página pide `confirm()` antes de borrar y recarga la lista.
- La medición de `ppc` fue 22 líneas de producción y 122 de pruebas, dentro del presupuesto de 200.
- `npm test` pasó (22 de 22) y `npm run typecheck` salió limpio antes de cerrar.

**Deuda propuesta** (queda como `proposed`; decide un humano)
- **DEBT-FE-002** (test, riesgo medio): la confirmación de borrado solo se comprueba buscando `confirm(` y `DELETE` en el texto de `public/app.js`. Si se quitara el `return` tras cancelar, las pruebas seguirían pasando. El botón tampoco reacciona a un DELETE fallido.
- **DEBT-BE-005** (diseño, riesgo bajo): el id se lee con `Number()`, así que `0x1` o `1e0` borran la tarea 1 en vez de dar 404.

**Desviaciones registradas**
- El 404 usa la forma de error que ya tiene la API, decidida en green sin registro. No hace falta ADR.
- «No vuelve tras reiniciar» se prueba solo con `kill -9` y reinicio, sin caso de cierre ordenado.

**Lo que no pude verificar**
- No ejecuté mutation testing. `ppc` rechazó que yo informara `mutation_score` porque lo calcula él, así que no sé el valor.
- Ningún navegador ejecutó el comportamiento de la página (confirmar, borrar, recargar).

Mi primer comando combinado fue rechazado por el shell. No escribió nada, así que repetí los pasos con las herramientas de edición.
